1  @echo off
2  cd ..
3
4 +echo Clear external\bin
5 +set "EMPTY_DIR=%TEMP%\empty_%RANDOM%"
6 +mkdir "%EMPTY_DIR%"
7 +robocopy "%EMPTY_DIR%" "artgine\external\bin" /MIR /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS
8 +rmdir "%EMPTY_DIR%"
9 +
10  echo [STEP] Electron package...
11  call npx electron-packager . Artgine ^
12  --platform=win32 ^
